method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Defines licence, group of licences and timber licence for the 2003 take-back; no bearing on a block.
Defines allowable annual cut of a TFL in a group for the take-back reductions.
Reduced listed licences' AAC and cut 20% off every timber licence area in 2003; it changes tenure holdings, not the rules a block must meet.
Minister's orders attributing the 2003 AAC and timber licence area reductions and naming the land removed; a block on deleted timber licence or TFL land would fall outside that tenure.
Holders must supply information for the reduction orders; offence for failing to.
Licences and timber licences are deemed amended to reflect the 2003 reductions and orders.
Compensation to licence holders for the 2003 reductions; no bearing on a block.
Caps compensation and bars further actions; no bearing on a block.
Retroactive effect of the Act in proceedings.
BC Forestry Revitalization Trust funding; no bearing on a block.
Cabinet may amend the Schedule of licences for name corrections, consolidations, subdivisions and transfers.
Regulation-making powers for valuation and compensation; the section text in the source also carries the Act's Schedule of licences and reductions.
Lists the licences, by licensee and licence number, whose allowable annual cut the 2003 Act reduced, with the volume taken back from each.
